scope.implementation: R3 request-owned authorized index, hard-interval retrieval, trusted current-activity selection

methodology.test_environment: PHP -n with network entrypoints disabled; new synthetic SQLite :memory: only; no application bootstrap

findings.summary: Microsecond boundaries lost precision when Yii batchInsert string-cast floating UTC seconds using PHP precision=14.

reproduction.failure: Unchanged source incorrectly failed assertCurrent with index_changed.

findings.resolution: Publisher explicitly binds six-decimal endpoints as PDO string values and temporarily disables stringify fetches for interval integrity reads, restoring settings in finally. Retriever uses six-decimal bound endpoints.
findings.retest: Exact endpoint match, one microsecond earlier start, one microsecond later end, and equivalent timezone offsets behave correctly through actual publisher and retriever.

findings.summary: Process termination can bypass finally/destructor cleanup and leave derived generation rows. No generation timestamps or orphan collector exist in this slice.
findings.required_followup: Document as production lifecycle work before enabling persistent deployment; this isolated R3 slice cannot claim crash-safe lifecycle cleanup.

independent_probes.coverage: Compare SQL full-union coverage to DeterministicRuleEvaluator on disjoint, touching, overlapping, nested and absent candidate intervals plus multiple requested windows.

independent_probes.failure_semantics: Parent explicitly approved precheck preservation versus postcheck invalidation; the latter does not promise restoration of the old selection.

conclusion: No unresolved blocking findings for this isolated R3 slice. This review does not certify full R3, M1, production persistence, HTTP delivery, or production recommendation quality.
counting_note: 240 + 16 + 10 distinct final checks. The original 14 index checks are included in the final 16. Do not add this number to parent regression totals, which overlap. Corrected probe-harness setup attempts are not counted.

static_review.factory: NativeRuleDiscoveryFactory pins context and policy, injects explicit P8-authorized capability and leaves policy/batch/clock runtime owners external. It performs no auto-install, migration, HTTP registration, AI construction or synthetic default.
static_review.layering: CurrentEventSelectionWriter and SelectCurrentEvent stay framework-free; SQL, native eligibility, session identity and migrations remain adapters.
static_review.authorization: Complete eligible roster is read in bounded batches. The post-recall source fingerprint includes each complete projection, both scope/content/permission versions, identity and P8 policy, plus evidence and unknown features. It is an observed fingerprint, not a durable permission epoch.
static_review.index_storage: Random request-owned generations use SHA-256 exact normalized tokens and UTC interval boundaries. Plain encoding remains a compatibility mode for synthetic/nonmanaged providers; production managed publisher uses sha256. Hashes are not anonymization.
static_review.hard_conditions: All hard predicates precede route LIMIT. Explicit preference uses alternatives; token requirements retain independent rule sources; time requires complete union coverage rather than any overlap.
static_review.current_selection: Server actor and active session determine identity. SQL row is keyed by actor plus namespaced session hash. Random revisions and conditional mutations prevent stale overwrite. Selection facts alone do not grant access; NativeCurrentEventAccess validates current native account, Space, membership and blocks.
static_review.exceptions: Index public boundaries reconstruct bounded exceptions without retaining the upstream error. Selection identity reads likewise discard original exception chains. Synthetic marker probes tested enabled exception trace arguments.

remaining_limits: Only fresh synthetic SQLite :memory: was exercised; real MySQL execution plans, migration behavior and production performance are not certified.
Finite before/after observation does not guarantee an atomic cross-module snapshot or detect every ABA history change.
Process crashes can bypass finally/destructor. Generation orphan collection and runtime storage lifecycle remain deployment work.
Fulltext-named route currently means exact normalized lexical token equality; no general free-text tokenizer, embeddings, or semantic provider was introduced.
No HTTP activity action, CSRF mapping, production PolicyStore, DiscoveryBatchStore or Clock implementation is supplied by the factory; ordinary API/pagination remain subsequent tasks.
No AI, idea target, raw identity display projection, complete historical applications, module enablement, production connection or deployment was independently certified.
